method: orthogonal projection abliteration applied as a direct weight edit (no LoRA, no PEFT merge)
container_note: Converted with --no-nextn. The base model carries an MTP block (15 mtp.* tensors) that AutoModelForCausalLM does not model; carrying those tensors over produced a GGUF that LOADED but failed at inference with 'Compute error' after ~5 prompts. Excluding the MTP block and letting the converter write consistent metadata (block_count 32, recurrent_layers 32, no nextn key) is the configuration that runs reliably.

evaluation.measured_on: NVIDIA RTX 3090 via llama.cpp b12549, Q5_K_M GGUF, greedy decoding
misses: Count the letters in the word 'strawberry' -> '9' (the untouched base model also answers 9; known tokenization failure, not ablation damage)
A farmer has 3 hens ... -> emitted reasoning prose ('we can break it down...') instead of the number, truncated by the token budget

caveats: Suites are smoke tests (30 capability / 16 refusal / 20 degeneration), greedy decoding, single turn.
Refusal is an anchored regex plus substring fallback on 16 prompts; it does not establish absence of refusal generally.
Local Metal runs on the 16GB test machine intermittently failed with GGML_STATUS_ALLOC_FAILED when another model server was resident; those were memory faults, not model faults.
LM Studio (0.4.28+2) refuses the MTP variant at compute time; this text-only build is the one intended for LM Studio.
